page.title: Daylight daily checklist and tomorrow plan
page.userContext: A mobile wellness user checks a small set of gentle daily commitments, wants calm progress feedback, and may prepare tomorrow after completing today.
assumptions: Today contains three stable habits and local state, so no loading or remote failure state is required.
Checking an item is reversible and should never require confirmation.

intents.goal: See and complete today's gentle commitments without pressure or visual density.
intents.successSignal: Each item updates immediately and the page clearly shows all three complete.

intents.goal: Understand remaining effort and recent consistency at a glance.
intents.successSignal: Progress count, remaining copy, and per-item supporting context agree.

intents.goal: Carry an intentional set of habits into tomorrow after today's work is complete.
intents.successSignal: A dedicated plan state confirms tomorrow's selected habits and returns to the journey.

intents.goal: Undo an accidental completion without losing the state of other habits.
intents.successSignal: Unchecking one item reopens progress and leaves every other item unchanged.

information.content: Date, calm page purpose, completed count, remaining count, and the three habit items.
information.placement: The progress summary follows the heading and precedes a vertically breathable checklist.
information.visibility: Visible throughout incomplete, partial, complete, and reopened states.

information.content: Habit label, short supporting cue, streak context, and checked state.
information.placement: Supporting copy and streak stay inside the same item surface beneath the primary label.
information.visibility: Each item remains visible after completion so it can be reviewed or undone.

information.content: Tomorrow's date, included habits, reminder state, and saved-plan confirmation.
information.placement: A focused planning page appears only after the completion action and keeps the final save action last.
information.visibility: Visible while planning and in the saved confirmation state.

reuse.need: Progress summary, breathable task items, reversible completion, and a next step after all items are done.
reuse.rationale: The pattern captures the intended breathing room and state feedback without turning the list into a dense backlog.

reuse.need: Persistent Today, Journey, Insights, and Profile destinations plus a focused planning detail.
reuse.rationale: Planning is a detail of the Today flow and should not falsely select Journey until the user finishes.

reuse.need: Reversible checked state for each habit.
reuse.rationale: The public checkbox owns checked and focus semantics while Daylight owns progress and completion feedback.

interactions.trigger: The user checks or unchecks one habit item.

transitions.event: The final habit is checked again

interactions.trigger: After all habits are complete, the user opens planning and saves tomorrow's selection.

feedback.immediate: The checkbox and progress count update in the same frame.
feedback.persistent: Completed items remain visible and the completion summary stays until an item is reopened.
feedback.recovery: Unchecking the affected item reverses only that item and hides the premature completion action.
feedback.announcement: Each checkbox exposes its label and checked state; progress text follows the heading in reading order.

feedback.immediate: The planning page becomes a saved summary with tomorrow's habit count.
feedback.persistent: Journey shows Tuesday as planned after the user continues.
feedback.recovery: Back before saving returns to the complete Today page; selected habits remain local to the planning draft.
feedback.announcement: The saved-plan heading and summary precede the Continue to journey action.

bestPractices.decision: Only the Daylight checklist receives increased vertical spacing and richer item context; other example apps retain their appropriate density.
bestPractices.evidence: The isolated habit preview checks both completion states and brightness modes; Daylight page previews inspect the checklist at 390x844 and 320x700.

bestPractices.decision: Plan tomorrow appears after completion and opens a focused detail rather than crowding the initial checklist.
bestPractices.evidence: Today, Day complete, Plan tomorrow, Plan saved, and Journey page previews use the real DaylightViewModel; widget interaction verifies the full transition path.

expected: Completion feedback replaces the gentle cue
Plan tomorrow is no longer promoted
